messages:
leah: Postmortem follow-up for the API gateway incident. Main action: update runbook playbook for routing /fallback rules, emergency switches, and precise escalation labels. Need owners for each chunk.

martin: I'll take the emergency switch docs and add the exact commands to flip traffic to fallback cluster. Commands include `rctl route set --service api-gateway --target fallback`, `kubectl patch svc api-gateway -p '{"spec": {"externalIPs": ["10.0.0.5"]}}'` plus notes on DNS TTL effects. ETA 4 days.

hana: I'll do the triage playbook edits for gateway 503s and TLS handshake failures. Add steps: 1) `curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/healthz` and check TLS chain, 2) `ss -tnp` on edge nodes, 3) verify cert expiry with `openssl s_client -connect $HOST:443 -showcerts`. PR by EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: Created follow-ups: GW-991, GW-992, GW-993.

carlos: Also propose adding a 'who to page' list with rotation windows and a fallback Slack channel. Add a quick checklist to runbook so first responders can redirect traffic within 3 mins. I'll draft the paging template.

leah: Owners and deadlines: martin -> emergency switches (4d), hana -> triage playbook (PR tomorrow), carlos -> paging template + contact list (2d). Please update here if anything slips.

martin: Note about DNS: include guidance to lower DNS TTL before a planned cutover, doc why changes may take up to TTL to propagate and when to use traffic shift vs IP patch.

hana: Also adding a 'postmortem quick capture' stub in the runbook for responders to paste initial logs and a checklist to trigger a full postmortem if error budget >1% in 24h.

leah: Great, will link PRs here when ready and close out GW issues when merged.
